name: Max Elements for Elementor – Advanced Widgets, Extensions & Theme Builder
author: Highend Themes

sections.description:
Max Elements is a powerful and lightweight Elementor extension that gives you everything you need to design stunning websites — faster and without writing any code. Max Elements brings you professional widgets, dynamic query and slider builders, template kits, WooCommerce tools, theme building options, popup/offcanvas capabilities, and much more.

Upgrade your Elementor experience with an all-in-one toolkit designed for developers, designers, and business owners.

Free and Pro functionalities are mixed in the Widgets below.

Plugin Demo Page

🔥 Key Features:

  • Elementor Template Kits
  • Dynamic Query Builder
  • Dynamic Slider Builder
  • Loop Grid / Carousel / Slider
  • Header, Footer, Blog & WooCommerce Builder
  • Popup & Offcanvas Builder
  • Advanced Extensions (Sticky Header, Gradient Backgrounds, Parallax Effects, and more)
  • Form integrations (Contact Form 7, WP Forms)
  • Priority Support with Pro Version

Widgets Included

📌 Elementor Elements:

  • Accordion
  • Animated Text
  • Button
  • Contact Form 7
  • Flipbox
  • Heading
  • Icon
  • Icon List
  • Image Accordion
  • Image Comparison
  • Image Hotspots
  • Advanced Image
  • Lottie Animation
  • Marquee
  • Nav Menu
  • Modern Services
  • Rotate Circle
  • Search
  • Testimonials Slider
  • Timeline
  • WP Forms

📰 Blog Builder Widgets:

  • Blog Feed Title
  • Blog Feed Image
  • Blog Feed Date
  • Blog Feed Author
  • Blog Feed Content
  • Blog Feed Tags
  • Blog Feed Categories
  • Blog Feed Read More
  • Blog Feed Comments
  • Blog Feed Sidebar

🛒 WooCommerce Widgets:

  • Woo Cart
  • Woo Checkout
  • Woo Mini Cart
  • Woo Shop Grid
  • Add to Cart
  • Product Filters
  • Product Price

⚡ Dynamic Widgets:

  • Dynamic Accordion
  • Dynamic Tabs
  • Dynamic Slider
  • Dynamic Query
  • Dynamic Post Meta

Theme Builder

  • Build Custom Templates for Posts, Pages, Products, Archives, 404, Search Results
  • Header & Footer Builder
  • Use Conditions to assign templates
  • Support for Custom Post Types
  • Use any Elementor widget within your templates

Popup & Offcanvas Builder

  • Trigger on: Page Load, Scroll, Exit Intent, Inactivity, Click, Scroll to Element
  • Use Prebuilt Library or Design from Scratch
  • GDPR Notices, Age Gates, Welcome Mats, Promos, Countdowns, Cookie Consent

Extensions

  • Sticky Header
  • Gradient Background (3 Colors)
  • Blur & Parallax Effects
  • Advanced Hover Effects
  • Custom CSS for Any Widget
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Elementor editor and search for “Max Elements” widgets.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor Pro for this to work?

No, Max Elements works with the free version of Elementor, but some features (like theme builder) require Elementor Pro.

Is it compatible with any theme?

Yes, Max Elements is compatible with all modern WordPress themes that follow coding standards.

Does it slow down my website?

Not at all. Max Elements is built to be lightweight and performance-optimized.
